subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept this grouped set of action-runtime changes in credential-bearing and security-owned workflows after targeted owner validation?
rationale: The patch has no concrete correctness finding, but CI cannot decide whether the combined token, registry, Codex, scanning, release, and administration behavior change is acceptable within the repository's security and operational boundaries.

options.title: Approve after targeted validation
options.body: Rebase, verify the exact pins, obtain secops/CI-owner review, and merge after the affected workflow gates complete successfully.

options.title: Split sensitive action updates
options.body: Separate token, login, Codex, CodeQL, and release-action upgrades from routine setup, labeling, and stale-action bumps if targeted validation cannot cover the grouped change.

options.title: Pause the grouped bump
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged and allow narrower Dependabot updates when the combined operational blast radius is not worth accepting now.

recommendation.title: Approve after targeted validation
recommendation.body: Rebase, verify the exact pins, obtain secops/CI-owner review, and merge after the affected workflow gates complete successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal spans both Codex-agent workflows and Docker/action-runtime maintenance, while CODEOWNERS separately requires secops review for central security workflows.
